$schema: Nusuk DL template contract v1 (see 14-templates-and-patterns.md; DESIGN.md › M9T)
name: Requests list
job: Every request of the person in one service, current and past.
useFor: Finding a request and opening its tracking page.
notFor: Today or a landing: there, use upcoming-requests with the next requests only.

forbidden: More than two or three tabs.
Filters that hide an active request.

allowed: RequestCard of the service; RequestCard empty state or EmptyState when there is none.

rules: Newest first; active requests before past ones.
One card type in the list (M9P rule 8).
The empty state says what will appear here and leads to the service.
The whole card opens the request; the arrow is not the only target (M10).

allocation.Band: Band 2, commitment state. Not suppressed in sacred windows.
allocation.Withheld: Status for everyone; controls only for Independents and Caregivers.

measure.guardrails: support tickets asking where a request is
